title: Map interaction and question focus
body:
- On desktop, the question field restores typing focus after submissions and mouse clicks or right-clicks on the map.
- Map interactions during a pending question restore focus when the response arrives and the input is available again.
- Map clicks preserve the draft and caret, and rejected submissions retain the draft.
- Map controls, keyboard navigation, other forms, and touch interactions do not trigger map-click focus restoration; page load does not autofocus the question field.

This release also includes the previously prepared persistent disk-backed question-plan and flag-SVG caches. Saved player progress, game rules, and question and guess limits are unchanged.
